newsitem.title: USA: Nu-Kote Holdings stake upped by Centennial.
newsitem.headline: Nu-Kote Holdings stake upped by Centennial.

text.p: A group led by Centennial Associates L.P. said Friday it raised its stake in Nu-kote Holdings Inc to 2,160,700 common shares or 9.92 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 249,000 common shares between January 31 and March 13 at prices ranging from $3.50 to $9.3750 per share.
Nu-Kote Holdings, based in Dallas, Tx., is an independent manufacturer and marketer of supplies for printing devices.
